::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hua Hong's second 12-inch fab in Wuxi, financed with the largest single Big Fund-backed deal since the October 2022 US export control tightening — $4.02B new equity (Hua Hong Group, the Big Fund, and a Wuxi entity) plus $2.68B in debt. Began risk production at end-2024 and passed 40,000 wafers of single-month input in December 2025, per Hua Hong's 2025 annual report; tools for the full 83,000 wafers/month design capacity were moved in by end of June 2026, with that capacity targeted for the end of Q3 2026.
:::

**Chinese name:** 华虹无锡二期（Fab 9） (Huáhóng Wúxī Èrqī)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers at mature specialty nodes (65nm, 55nm, 40nm) — power management, automotive, and analog chips, not leading-edge logic.

## Why does it matter?

Illustrates China's mature-node strategy: rather than chase export-controlled advanced lithography, state capital doubles down on nodes where China already has working equipment access. Hua Hong announced a THIRD Wuxi phase in September 2026 — a separate US$6.95 billion project (Hua Hong group's own share about $2.127 billion), with construction having started in March 2026 — now tracked as its own entry, `huahong-wuxi-phase3`, signaling this is an open-ended expansion programme rather than a one-off Phase 2 project.

## Project Timeline

- **Jan 2023** — Hua Hong Semiconductor, the Big Fund, and a Wuxi entity sign agreement for a $6.7 billion second 12-inch Wuxi fab (Fab9)
- **Jun 2023** — Construction of Fab9 begins
- **Sep 2023** — Fab9's main building topped out roughly 100 days ahead of schedule
- **Dec 2024** — Hua Hong Manufacturing (Wuxi) Fab9 enters risk production (designed for 83,000 wafers/month at full build)
- **Mar 2026** — Construction begins on a separate Wuxi Phase 3 project (US$6.95 billion total)
- **Jun 2026** — Fab9 process-equipment move-in completed; full-capacity ramp targeted for end of Q3 2026
- **Sep 2026** — Hua Hong Semiconductor formally announces the Wuxi Phase 3 joint venture: US$6.95 billion total (US$4.17B equity, US$2.78B debt), group share about US$2.127 billion, 55,000 wafers/month
